recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed unless a future rendered artifact outside current source reintroduces the old malformed placeholder.
issue_request: FHIR-14018 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 technical correction asking that an XML primitive example change from a malformed combined id/value attribute shape to separate, correctly quoted id and value attributes.
initial_application: The issue was historically applied in svn revision 12766, preserved as git commit d48e59c5b09bf2f60a9646a7b93fb8cbab8c7ef7 (`#14018 - fix typo`), which edited source/element.html at the primitive XML example.
additional_context: The old source/element.html placeholder example has been refactored away. The current documentation surface links to source/xml.html as the XML Format page, and source/xml.html now shows primitive XML examples with a concrete birthDate element using separate `id="314159"` and `value="1970-03-30"` attributes. Zulip contained only the original tracker bot mention, and Confluence had no references.
reconciliation: No source change was made because current source already conveys the corrected XML syntax and searches found no remaining malformed placeholder text.
